name: scout-repos
description: Connect Claude to your GitHub account to search GitHub, rate repositories with a 0-100 quality score, safely clone and install repos, and find the best code or models for any task.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: A fine-grained GitHub personal access token with read-only Contents, Metadata, Issues and Pull requests. Enables the GitHub tools. Leave empty to use the GitHub CLI sign-in (gh auth login) instead.
